connector.name: Discord MCP by cappyeo
connector.registryDescription: Connect MCP-compatible AI clients to Discord through a typed local server with 192 tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cli. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cappyeo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
env.description: Discord bot token. The optional Bot prefix is accepted.
